description: Re-scoped CAM-4 (filed pre-CAM-42). Two of its three text-scraping points are already gone: loop termination is state-driven via decideNextAction reading prd.json (CAM-22), and the cam-plan PTY APPROVE byte-scan path was removed (the isApproveLine/findApproveLine helpers are now dead vestigial code). The third point (capture-pane sentinel) is the deliberate CAM-42 design and is already corroboration-only behind state-primary handoff.json/prd.json (CAM-32); the stream-json alternative the issue proposed is ruled out because claude -p is forbidden (subscription rule, CAM-42). This issue therefore reduces to removing the dead byte-scan surface and recording the architecture reality honestly.
docsConsultedRationale: No external library touched: deletion of dead in-repo helpers + their tests, plus a markdown architecture note. No npm API exercised. The stream-json path the original issue referenced is intentionally NOT pursued (claude -p forbidden, CAM-42).

userStories.title: Delete the dead cam-plan APPROVE byte-scan helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the vestigial PTY APPROVE-detection helpers removed so no one can re-wire a fragile text-scraping gate that the issue flagged; the live runPlan path already does not use them.
acceptanceCriteria: isApproveLine and findApproveLine are removed from src/commands/plan.ts (the live runPlan path does not call them: the PTY/foreground inherit path was removed and APPROVE happens inside the pane).

The corresponding test blocks for isApproveLine and findApproveLine are removed from test/plan.test.ts, along with their imports; the remaining plan tests (buildPlanArgv, parsePlanArgs, runPlan) still pass.
No other file in src/ or test/ imports isApproveLine or findApproveLine (verified by grep returning nothing after the change).
The '// --- Verdict detection helpers (kept for future APPROVE-in-pane detection) ---' section header in plan.ts is removed with the functions.
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/plan.ts (remove the two functions + their section comment at ~lines 66-90), test/plan.test.ts (remove the two describe blocks ~lines 79-122 and the two names from the import at lines 28-29; also the coverage-comment lines 6-7). Only these two functions are dead; buildPlanArgv/parsePlanArgs/runPlan stay. Grep `isApproveLine\|findApproveLine` after editing to confirm zero hits remain.

userStories.title: Reconcile FLOW.md to the supervisor model and record the state-driven architecture
userStories.description: As a future maintainer reading CAM-4, I want FLOW.md to stop describing the retired stop-hook + <promise> loop as live and instead reflect the supervisor model, so the doc matches the code and the structured-signal reality is recorded honestly.
acceptanceCriteria: FLOW.md section 7 ('O loop autonomo') and section 8 ('State machine do loop') no longer describe the stop hook re-injecting /cam-next each turn, nor <promise>COMPLETE</promise> as the termination signal: they describe the deterministic TS supervisor (runSupervisor) driving the loop, with decideNextAction reading prd.json + the review verdict to decide implement / review / complete (CAM-22).

The section-4 flowchart line that says cam next 'materializa stop hook' (around line 220) is corrected: cam next runs the supervisor, which dispatches TUI worker sessions and polls capture-pane for the sentinel (CAM-42); no stop hook is materialized.

The doc states the worker outcome is state-primary: handoff.json (which story) + prd.json passes:true (done) are authoritative, and the capture-pane sentinel (CAM_*_STATUS / <review>) is corroboration only, never a gate (CAM-32).

The doc states the stream-json / --include-hook-events approach is intentionally NOT used because claude -p is forbidden for subscription accounts (CAM-42), so the structured signal lives in on-disk state files (handoff.json / prd.json), not an event stream.

Still-true facts are preserved: the --completion-promise and --max-iter flags of cam next still exist (the completion promise is recorded in the state file for display via cam status, it just does not drive termination).

README.md is checked and, if it carries a matching stop-hook / <promise> description of the worker model, it is corrected to the same supervisor + sentinel reality; if it is already accurate, it is left untouched.
No em-dash appears in the edited markdown (use colon, comma, parens, or period).
userStories.notes: Files: FLOW.md (repo ROOT, not docs/) sections 7 (~lines 363-413) and 8 (~lines 417-447), plus the section-4 line ~220 ('materializa stop hook'). README.md only if it has a matching stale section. The stop-hook + <promise> + /cam-next re-injection model was retired in CAM-22/CAM-42; the live model is runSupervisor (src/supervisor/loop.ts) + decideNextAction (reads prd.json) + TUI workers + capture-pane sentinel that is corroboration-only (src/supervisor/result.ts, CAM-32). KEEP the --completion-promise / --max-iter flags (still parsed in index.ts); only fix the false mechanism claims. NO em-dash in persisted md. This is the honest closing record for CAM-4, factual not new design.
